resources.string: FocusForce+ uses this accessibility service for exactly one purpose: detecting which app you open, so that apps you chose to block can be covered with a blocking screen. The service cannot read any screen content (window content access is disabled), collects no data, and nothing ever leaves your device. You can turn this service off here at any time — your blocking rules stay saved and blocking simply pauses.

If you switch Reels or Shorts off in FocusForce+, or give them a daily time, this service leaves them when you open them or when the time is used up: inside Instagram and YouTube only, and only the one you switched on, it watches for the Reels and Shorts player and presses Back once, so you land on the rest of the app. It reads no text and looks at no other app. With a daily time it keeps today\'s minutes in the player; nothing else is stored, and nothing is sent: FocusForce+ has no internet access. Turn it off here at any time.
